description:
Create or increase a leveraged sBTC position (up to 1.5x) on your Pillar smart wallet. Agent-signed, no browser needed. Your sBTC is supplied to Zest, borrowed against, and re-supplied for amplified Bitcoin exposure. Backend sponsors gas. For simple yield without leverage, use pillar_direct_supply instead.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

minSbtcFromSwap.description: Min sBTC from swap in sats (slippage protection)

sbtcAmount.description: sBTC amount in sats to supply as collateral

name: pillar_direct_boost
